messages.content: Update on the Ontario/Rancho trip. The spare sensor kit is at the plant, Thursday closeout is off, and they confirmed the Milliken visitor gate. They added a Wednesday controls debrief from 2:30 to about 3:30 before I can leave. Can we move from comparison to booking?

Yes. Cleanest version is now Mon Mar 9 OAK to ONT nonstop, 2:25 p.m. to 3:45 p.m., then Wed Mar 11 ONT to SFO nonstop, 7:05 p.m. to 8:35 p.m. The cheaper connecting options save about $80 but add a Phoenix or LAX connection and make Wednesday less predictable.
Use the Oakland outbound. It is easier Monday than getting to SFO. Does that 7:05 return leave enough room after the debrief?

It works if the debrief ends near 3:30. Leave the plant around 4:00, allow 35-45 minutes to ONT, return the car by about 5:40, and you still have a reasonable airport buffer. If they run past 4:15 it gets tighter, but it is still cleaner than the connecting returns.
Book those flights. Add a compact car at ONT, pay at counter, not prepaid.

Before I finalize the rest: outbound OAK-ONT is Southwest, so no assigned seat, but I can add EarlyBird and a check-in reminder. Return ONT-SFO has 19A available. Hotel still Hyatt Place Ontario/Rancho Cucamonga for Mar 9-11? It has strong guest feedback, parking, and restaurants nearby.
Yes, use that Hyatt. Put a room note for coffee maker and mini-fridge. And take 19A on the return.

Booked. Flights: Mon OAK-ONT 2:25-3:45 nonstop; Wed ONT-SFO 7:05-8:35 nonstop, seat 19A. I added EarlyBird/check-in reminder for the Southwest outbound. Rental: compact at ONT, pickup Mon 4:00 p.m., return Wed 5:45 p.m., pay at counter, unlimited mileage.
Hotel confirmation too?

Confirmed: Hyatt Place Ontario/Rancho Cucamonga, king room, Mar 9-11, flexible cancellation until Mar 8 at 6:00 p.m., parking included. The room note requests a coffee maker and mini-fridge; the front desk says standard rooms include both, but the note is attached.
Send me the two-day plant agenda with Wednesday fixed.

Draft: Mon Mar 9 land ONT 3:45, pick up car, check in, dinner near Ontario Mills/Rancho. Tue Mar 10 leave hotel 7:45, Milliken visitor gate 8:15, membrane skid walkthrough 8:30-11:30, lunch with maintenance lead, instrumentation review 2:00-4:00, notes back at hotel. Wed Mar 11 leave hotel 5:15, gate 5:45, CIP observation 6:00-10:30, controls cleanup after lunch, debrief 2:30-3:30, depart plant by 4:00.
Shift Tuesday. They specifically said don't hit the gate before 8:15, so leave the hotel closer to 8:00.

Updated final agenda: Mon Mar 9 OAK 2:25 p.m. to ONT 3:45, compact car, Hyatt check-in and dinner nearby. Tue Mar 10 leave hotel 8:00, Milliken visitor gate 8:15, membrane skid walkthrough 8:30-11:30, lunch, instrumentation review 2:00-4:00. Wed Mar 11 leave hotel 5:15 for 6:00 CIP observation, controls cleanup, 2:30-3:30 debrief, leave plant around 4:00, return car by 5:45, ONT-SFO 7:05 p.m.

messages.content: Switching gears from work travel. My wife and I are thinking Santa Fe for a Friday-to-Monday long weekend, April 17-20. Two tickets to Albuquerque, rental car from there. She may be able to leave after lunch Friday, but not confirmed.
Got it. For that window, are you okay with one connection each way? The nonstop choices into Albuquerque from the Bay Area are thin, and the one-stop options are much more workable.

One reasonable connection is fine. I don't want a two-stop slog. Compare midafternoon versus early evening departures. Hotel should be near the Plaza, well rated, flexible cancellation, and easy to walk to dinner. This one doesn't need to be optimized like a plant trip.

Best midafternoon flight I see: SFO 1:55 p.m. to DEN, 1 hour 25 minute connection, then ABQ 7:38 p.m. You would likely reach Santa Fe around 9:15-9:30 after bags and the drive. Early evening option: SFO 5:05 p.m. via DEN, ABQ around 10:55 p.m., which means Santa Fe after midnight. OAK has a Southwest one-stop via Phoenix around 2:35 p.m., arriving ABQ about 8:15.
So if she can get out by noon, the 1:55 is the practical one?

Yes. It is the best fit if noon is realistic. It leaves enough time to get to SFO without rushing too badly and still makes a late Santa Fe dinner possible. The early-evening flight is an acceptable backup only if dinner Friday is not important.
What about Monday coming home? Afternoon is fine, but I don't want to land at 11 p.m.

Best fit return: ABQ 1:20 p.m. via DEN, arrive SFO about 5:50 p.m. That gives you the morning in Santa Fe and gets you home at a sane hour. Backup: ABQ 2:10 p.m. via Phoenix to OAK, arrive around 6:15 p.m. Later ABQ options push the Bay Area arrival toward 9:30 or later.
Give me the hotel shortlist.

Drury Plaza Hotel: about 4.6 guest rating, easy Plaza walk, on-site bar/restaurant, breakfast, flexible rate available, parking fee. Inn on the Alameda: also about 4.6, quieter, walkable to the Plaza and Canyon Road, breakfast, flexible rate, usually easier parking. Hotel Chimayo: very close to the Plaza, around 4.3, more historic feel, rooms can vary. Rosewood is excellent but jumps into a different price tier.
Price check Drury and Inn on the Alameda. Skip Rosewood pricing.

Drury is about $1,020 before taxes and parking for three nights, cancellable until 48 hours before arrival. Inn on the Alameda is about $1,150 before taxes, cancellable until 72 hours before, with a calmer feel and parking included or simpler depending on room type. Drury is the better value and slightly more central.
Rental car?

ABQ midsize is about $214 total, pay later; compact is about $189. For two people plus bags and the Santa Fe drive, midsize is the best fit. Shortlist: best fit is SFO-DEN-ABQ midafternoon Friday, Drury Plaza, midsize car, and ABQ-DEN-SFO at 1:20 Monday. Acceptable backup is the OAK/Southwest routing or Inn on the Alameda. Ask before booking: confirm your wife's noon departure, decide if a 9:30-ish Friday dinner is okay, and whether to hold Drury while the flexible rate is still there.

Yes. Drury Plaza, flexible rate. Midsize car, pay later.

Booked: flights for two, Drury Plaza Santa Fe Apr 17-20, and midsize rental from ABQ with pickup around 8:00 p.m. Friday and return around noon Monday. Seat map has pairs available: 18A/18B, 14A/14B, 16A/16B, and 20A/20B.
Use those. Keeping us together matters more than both having ideal seats.
Seats selected together, window plus middle on each leg: 18A/18B SFO-DEN, 14A/14B DEN-ABQ, 16A/16B ABQ-DEN, and 20A/20B DEN-SFO.
Friday timing still works for Santa Fe dinner?

It works, but it is a late-dinner plan. Land ABQ 7:38, get bags and car around 8:15, drive to Santa Fe, and reach Drury around 9:25 if traffic is normal. Best fit is a 9:30 reservation or a place with kitchen service until 10.
Don't book dinner yet. Just give me the final travel summary.

Final Santa Fe weekend: Fri Apr 17 SFO 1:55 p.m. to DEN to ABQ 7:38 p.m., pick up midsize rental at ABQ, drive to Drury Plaza Santa Fe for Apr 17-20 on a flexible rate. Seats are paired A/B on all legs. Mon Apr 20 return car around noon, fly ABQ 1:20 p.m. via DEN, arrive SFO 5:50 p.m. Only optional follow-up is a first-night dinner reservation.
